note: Identity's cut at the assembled edge (Vexa-ai/vexa#1783): the person's own settings and workspace regime. The gateway fronts these routes (`core/identity/routes.v1.json`), so `forward` sends each tool call back through the gateway, carrying the identity it signed, rather than to admin-api directly.

tools.name: settings
tools.note: How Vexa behaves for THIS person — every setting and what each means. Call it before changing one.

tools.name: settings_set
tools.note: CHANGE ONE of the person's settings when they ask for something that is one; never edit a flow to achieve it. Unknown settings are refused with the list. Tell them what changed, in one line.

tools.name: workspace_regime
tools.note: Where the person's OWN workspace lives: `cloud` (server-side, default) or `local` (a directory on their machine).

tools.name: workspace_regime_set
tools.note: MOVE the person's own workspace when they ask: `local` with an ABSOLUTE `local_path`, or back to `cloud`. Group workspaces stay server-side either way.
